final: SELECT AVG(subquery.avg_fillcount) as result FROM (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark WHERE oe.expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow) subquery
